__comment: Storage Barrel - the first functional storage container (doc 19).
Follows the trade_counter.json schema. NEW fields established by doc 19:
item_key   - the resources.json ITEM form a dwarf fetches to install this piece
placement  - 'floor' | 'floor_wall' (floor_wall = needs a solid block behind the back face)
yaw_steps  - placement-ghost rotation steps (R key, 90 degrees each)
storage    - marks this piece as a storage container (capacity in ITEMS, flat count -
SH parity 2026-07-11; render_contents false = opaque density container)
description: A stout oak barrel bound in iron. Holds a small stock of whatever the colony hauls into it.
